gen-gf-montagu-slab-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa, a plain sans, holds one thickness in every direction, with stubby extenders beside a big x-height. Montagu Slab shades the title; that monoline column does the rest.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-gf-lexend-giga: Terminals finishing well short of the stem mark Montagu Slab. Lexend Giga, a sans-serif, takes the column in flat linework and wide tracking, while that serif stays refined up top.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-gf-lexend-mega: Soft thick-thin, a small cap-to-lowercase step, then Lexend Mega with a one-nib look and a gap on every c. Montagu Slab shades the title; that sans-serif holds the column.
gen-gf-montagu-slab-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta, a plain sans, cuts ribbon strokes of constant width, with widely tracked type. Lexend Zetta does the column; Montagu Slab does the title, a low-key thick-thin against no swing at all.
gen-gf-mynerve-archivo: Archivo, a plain sans, opens curves outward instead of curling in. Leave Mynerve large and brief, a hand-drawn heading of constant bowls with a visible gap on every c.
gen-gf-mynerve-clash-grotesk: Hand-drawn bowls that never change thickness, a gap on every c, then Clash Grotesk with no thick-and-thin at all. That plain sans wants a brief block under Mynerve.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-epilogue: Constant bowls, a gap on every c, then Epilogue on the title. Epilogue, a sans-serif, takes the column in unclamped curves with stubby ascender tips under Mynerve.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-erode: Round bowls that never change thickness mark Mynerve at once. Erode, a text serif, likes a modest size, a gentle ebb of weight under that handwritten title.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-supreme: Mynerve holds round bowls that never change thickness, with a visible gap on every c. Supreme, a sans-serif, leaves Mynerve large and brief above a heavy middle strip of open letters.
gen-gf-mynerve-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure, with an x-height that fills the line. Leave Mynerve large and brief above that unobstructed, clean column of filled midzone letters.
gen-gf-mynerve-gf-orbit: Relaxed is Mynerve, hand-drawn bowls of one thickness with a gap on every c. Orbit, a sans-serif, floats each character apart down the column, rope-like throughout.
gen-gf-mynerve-montserrat: Friendly is Mynerve, round bowls of one thickness with a gap on every c. Montserrat, a sans-serif, takes the column with oversized counters and a line that glides like wire.
gen-gf-mynerve-switzer: Switzer, a sans, keeps c tips from creeping toward touching, tubular letters with a high waist. Switzer holds the column under Mynerve, a handwritten heading of constant bowls.
gen-gf-mynerve-work-sans: Constant bowls, a gap on every c, then Work Sans with joins matching the strokes. And that sans-serif likes a modest size under Mynerve's hand-drawn title.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-archivo: Nanum Gothic Coding holds wide-mouthed curves, casual pen-and-paper letters bent from one length of tubing. And Archivo, a plain sans, takes the column with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height.
